provenance: Saved published scene calibration metadata; user confirmed these are measurements of elements inside the two selected scenes.

usage.existing_vggt: Compare predicted m/VGGT-unit to the stored scale for the identical original reconstruction, or multiply the saved measured distance by the predicted scale and compare to the real length.
usage.new_geometry_calibration: Identify the same measured element in the new geometry and compute real_length_m divided by its reconstructed length. Do not copy the original VGGT scale coefficient.
usage.automatic_scale_validation: Keep the known length out of automatic scale fitting; evaluate its prediction against the measured length.
usage.distortion: After anchor calibration, use separate geometric consistency and shape evidence. The calibrated anchor itself is not an independent distortion check.
